title: A headless agent can write by:operator into an item file or edit settings and hooks: Edit and Write are allowed without path limits and nothing checks the writer
goal: kb_hook.py (a PreToolUse hook registered in .claude/settings.json) refuses, when KB_HEADLESS_RUNNER is set, an Edit or Write of kb/_self/backlog/*.json that changes a gate's answer or by field, and of .claude/settings*.json, .claude/hooks/ and .claude-plugin/; a planted-failure test runs the hook on each tool call; the operator-present manager session is unaffected; found by the SP-itmjxudu review: bl_check cannot tell an operator answer from a forged one
